text:
Dana K.: Candidate (Liu Y) landed on a red-eye and asked if we can cover an overnight hotel and early breakfast before the 9am loop. Wants a fridge for meds + desk lamp.
Omar R.: We occasionally approve a single-night stay for red-eyes. Policy is up to $200 for SF hotels. Can we prebook and bill to the company card?
Priya (People Ops): Approved up to $200. I'll prebook a nearby hotel (walking distance) and mark "fridge needed" and "desk lamp" in the notes. Dana, please share check-in name and phone.
Dana K.: Sent details in DM. Also candidate asked if we can provide a portable battery pack — phone battery died on last trip.
Priya (People Ops): We have a small loaner power bank. I'll pack it with the badge envelope and label it.
travel-bot: Hotel reservation created: "Oak & Bay Inn" 1 night; confirmation #RB-7421. Billing: company-card; guest name: Liu Y.
Dana K.: Candidate also requested a very short 20-min optional video touch-base tonight at 8pm PST to meet their recruiter (non-evaluative). Panel ok with an optional chat?
Omar R.: Optional is fine; please ensure it is not recorded and not evaluative. Add note to calendar: "Optional intro, no feedback collected."
facilities-bot: Breakfast arranged: boxed continental (gluten-free option) delivered to front desk at 7:30 AM. Fridge request noted. Desk lamp will be in the room.
Priya (People Ops): For expenses: if candidate pays hotel and submits receipt, reimburse per policy. If we prebook, candidate signs no-shows on arrival. I'll attach expense guidance in the confirmation email.
Dana K.: Also candidate asked about parking for their partner who is driving to pick them up after the loop. Can we validate visitor parking for up to 4 hours?
Priya (People Ops): Yes. Front desk will issue a 4-hr parking voucher. I'll add that to the badge note.
travel-bot: Calendar updated: onsite loop 9:00-12:30, optional intro 8:00-8:20 PM (video). Reminders set.
Omar R.: Thanks team. If anything else pops up, ping #people-ops or @Priya.
Priya (People Ops): Closing loop — sending confirmation email to candidate now with hotel details, badge pickup, breakfast, power bank note, and expense instructions. :white_check_mark:
